# clipaste — dingdinglz hardened fork

> Authenticated clipboard-image bridge for trusted SSH/WSL accounts. Local
> clipboard is untouched by default; image retention defaults to one hour.

- [Repository and installation](https://github.com/dingdinglz/clipaste)
- [Security model](https://github.com/dingdinglz/clipaste/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Agent instructions](https://github.com/dingdinglz/clipaste/blob/main/AGENTS.md)
- [Full reference](llms-full.txt)

Do not use upstream Homebrew/binary releases as this fork's installation.
There is no advertised fork binary release yet. Review and build the source.
